name: honey-garden-crm
description: Honey Garden CRM - gestionale multi-tenant per agenzie OnlyFans

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@honey-garden/api & npm run dev --workspace=@honey-garden/web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@honey-garden/database && npm run build --workspace=@honey-garden/api && npm run build --workspace=@honey-garden/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@honey-garden/api && npm run lint --workspace=@honey-garden/web
